abilities.overallDescription: Defenders with this ability will have full vision of plays the offense has run via coach cam after the play has been called 4 times each quarter.

abilities.name: Steamroller - Silver
abilities.description: More resistant to tackles while moving at mid or high speed
abilities.overallDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability retain more of their forward momentum during tackles while travelling at mid or high speeds.

abilities.name: Pass Protector - Silver
abilities.description: Protection vs. quick pass block shed moves
abilities.overallDescription: Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick pass block shed move.

abilities.name: Pass Game Student - Gold
abilities.description: See all receiver route on 3rd/4th downs
abilities.overallDescription: See the play art of two of the receivers pre-snap on 3rd and 4th downs.

abilities.name: Homer - Gold
abilities.description: Reduced Zone objectives & increased composure in the home stadium
abilities.overallDescription: When playing at home; players with this ability can easily enter the Zone and have a boost to composure gains.

abilities.name: Short Route KO - Gold
abilities.description: Greatly improved KO chance/window in man vs. short routes
abilities.overallDescription: Defenders with this ability have a greatly improved chance to succeed at catch tackle knockouts; and a longer knockout window; in man-to-man versus short routes less than 10 yards from the LoS

abilities.name: Fastbreak - Gold
abilities.description: Greatly improved blocking & reduced fumble chance on designed QB runs
abilities.overallDescription: Passers with this ability receive much better blocking support and are less likely to fumble on designed quarterback run plays.

abilities.name: Deep In Elite - Gold
abilities.description: Improved catching and longer perfect window on deep passes inside the numbers
abilities.overallDescription: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently and have a longer perfect catch timing window while catching passes less than 20+ yards from the LoS; inside the numbers

abilities.name: Mid Zone KO - Gold
abilities.description: Greatly improved reactions & KO chance/window in mid zones
abilities.overallDescription: Defenders with this ability have a greatly improved chance to force catch knockouts; a longer knockout window; and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage; less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.

abilities.name: Post Up - Gold
abilities.description: Greatly improved double team blocks
abilities.overallDescription: Blockers with this ability have a greatly increased chance to win any double team block they are engaged in.

abilities.name: Inside Deadeye - Gold
abilities.description: Improved completions & perfect pass accuracy on throws inside the numbers
abilities.overallDescription: Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all unpressured throws inside the numbers (except on high throws). Those throws will also result in more completions.

abilities.name: Ripper - Gold
abilities.description: Rip rush moves ignore a large amount of blocker resistance
abilities.overallDescription: Defenders with this ability will ignore four bars of blocker resistance when attempting rip pass rush moves

abilities.name: Instant Rebate - Gold
abilities.description: Successful block sheds restore stamina & fatigue
abilities.overallDescription: Defenders with this ability are refunded stamina and heal a moderate amount of fatigue when they successfully shed blocks

abilities.name: Unpredictable - Gold
abilities.description: Shed wins are much less likely to add to blocker resistance & sometimes remove resistance
abilities.overallDescription: Defenders with this ability are much less likely to increase their blocker's resistance bars when performing shed wins; and occasionally remove a bar of blocker resistance on shed wins

abilities.name: Honorary Lineman - Gold
abilities.description: Greatly improved impact blocks vs. DB's
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability will have a greatly increased chance to win impact blocks against defensive backs.

abilities.name: Runoff Elite - Gold
abilities.description: Grants more convincing runoffs & improved run blocks
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability will distract defenders for longer with their runoffs and have improved run blocking

abilities.name: On The Ball - Gold
abilities.description: Grants improved reactions to runoffs & improved sheds
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability are much less likely to be fooled by WR runoffs and have an improved chance to shed impact blocks

abilities.name: Lockout - Gold
abilities.description: Long Arm rush moves ignore a large amount of blocker resistance
abilities.overallDescription: Defenders with this ability will ignore four bars of blocker resistance when attempting long arm pass rush moves

abilities.name: Leap Frog
abilities.description: Prevents fumbles while hurdling
abilities.overallDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability will hold onto the ball if tackled during a hurdle.

abilities.name: AKA Bruiser
abilities.description: Starts ON for 3 plays! More powerful truck & stiff arm animations
abilities.overallDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability have more powerful truck and stiff arm animations.
abilities.activationDescription: Charge Up: Offensive downs played 5 (sim) and 8 (comp)

abilities.name: Mobile Deadeye - Gold
abilities.description: Significant accuracy boost when on the run/cross body
abilities.overallDescription: Significantly more likely to make perfect on-the-run and cross-body throws while not under pressure except on high/low throws.

abilities.name: Pressure Cooker - Bronze
abilities.description: Slightly decreases pressure angle and distance.
abilities.overallDescription: Require defenders to be at a slightly closer distance and angle threshold in order to apply pressure to them.

abilities.name: Hurdle Elite - Gold
abilities.description: Ballcarriers with this ability do not fumble during hurdles and have a higher chance on both fakeouts and broken tackles on their first hurdle attempt
abilities.overallDescription: No fumbles during hurdles and a higher chance of both fakeouts and broken tackles on the first hurdle attempt.

abilities.name: Showboat - Silver
abilities.description: Moderately improved catching mid air.
abilities.overallDescription: Moderately improved catching mid-air.

abilities.name: Conductor - Bronze
abilities.description: Slightly faster hot routing & blocking adjustments
abilities.overallDescription: Make hot route and blocking adjustments slightly faster excluding audibles.

abilities.name: Conductor - Gold
abilities.description: Significantly faster hot routing & blocking adjustments
abilities.overallDescription: Make hot route and blocking adjustments significantly faster excluding audibles.

abilities.name: Elusive - Bronze
abilities.description: Slightly increases juke & spin fakeout chances.
abilities.overallDescription: Slightly more likely to fakeout defenders when using juke and spin moves.

abilities.name: Pass Lead elite
abilities.description: Increased throw power when leading bullet passes
abilities.overallDescription: Passers with this ability have increased throw power on bullet precision passes (except on high/low throws).

abilities.name: Quickdraw
abilities.description: Faster throwing animations when under pressure
abilities.overallDescription: Passers with this ability have faster passing animations when they are throwing under pressure.

abilities.name: Immovable Object - Bronze
abilities.description: Slightly increases chance to break sacks.
abilities.overallDescription: Slightly more likely to break sacks.

abilities.name: Afterburner - Silver
abilities.description: Moderately increased duration of Second Gear.
abilities.overallDescription: Gain the additional acceleration provided by Second Gear for a moderately longer duration.

abilities.name: Steamroller - Gold
abilities.description: More resistant to tackles while moving at any speed
abilities.overallDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability retain more of their forward momentum during tackles while travelling at any speed.

abilities.name: Agile Extender
abilities.description: Higher chance to evade the first sack by a blitzing DB
abilities.overallDescription: While in the pocket, passers with this ability are almost guaranteed to evade the first sack attempt by a blitzing defensive back.

abilities.name: AKA TE Apprentice
abilities.description: Starts ON for 4 plays! Four additional hot routes when lined up at TE
abilities.overallDescription: When lined up at tight end, players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments.
abilities.activationDescription: Charge Up: Offensive downs played 5 (sim) and 8 (comp)

abilities.name: Finesser - Bronze
abilities.description: Slightly better finesse moves
abilities.overallDescription: Slightly more likely to beat blockers using finesse pass rush moves.

abilities.name: WR Catch Drill - Silver
abilities.description: Moderately improves catching of 2 WR's.
abilities.overallDescription: Give two wide receivers a moderate boost to catching and holding on to passes.

abilities.name: Pass Rush Drill - Bronze
abilities.description: Improves pass block sheds of Left End.
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability grant their Left End faster pass rush moves for a better chance at shedding blocks.

abilities.name: AKA El Toro
abilities.description: Starts ON for 3 plays! Dominant bull rush wins from max pass rush points
abilities.overallDescription: Defenders with this ability will receive dominant bull rush wins when their pass rush points are full.
abilities.activationDescription: Charge Up: Defensive downs played 5 (sim) and 8 (comp)

abilities.name: AKA Tireless Runner
abilities.description: Starts ON for 3 plays! Improved tackle recovery on low stamina
abilities.overallDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability are effective at recovering from attempted tackles regardless of their current stamina.
abilities.activationDescription: Charge Up: Offensive downs played 5 (sim) and 8 (comp)

abilities.name: Showboat - Bronze
abilities.description: Slightly improved catching mid air.
abilities.overallDescription: Slightly improved catching mid-air.

abilities.name: AKA Evasive
abilities.description: Starts ON for 3 plays! Grants steerable spin & juke moves
abilities.overallDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke and spin animations.
abilities.activationDescription: Charge Up: Offensive downs played 5 (sim) and 8 (comp)

abilities.name: Knockout Drill - Bronze
abilities.description: Moderately increases knockout chances of 1 CB.
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability grant one of their Corner Backs a moderate boost to their chance of causing knockouts.

abilities.name: Iron Grip - Gold
abilities.description: Significantly increases pass catching chance when tackled.
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability have significantly increased chance to catch passes when tackled.

abilities.name: WR Catch Drill - Bronze
abilities.description: Moderately improves catching of 1 WR.
abilities.overallDescription: Give one wide receiver a moderate boost to catching and holding on to passes.

abilities.name: HB/TE Catch Drill - Bronze
abilities.description: Moderately improves catching of the HB.
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability grant one of their Running Backs a moderate boost to catching and holding on to passes.

abilities.name: HB/TE Catch Drill - Silver
abilities.description: Moderately improves catching of the HB & 1 TE.
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability grant one of their Running Backs and one of their Tight Ends a moderate boost to catching and holding on to passes.

abilities.name: HB/TE Catch Drill - Gold
abilities.description: Moderately improves catching of the HB & 2 TE's.
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability grant one of their Running Backs and two of their Tight Ends a moderate boost to catching and holding on to passes.

abilities.name: Block Shed Drill - Silver
abilities.description: Improves run block sheding of 2 Defensive Tackles.
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability grant both of their Defensive Tackles faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks.

abilities.name: Set Feet Lead
abilities.description: Increased THP when leading bullet passes with set feet
abilities.overallDescription: Passers with this ability have increased throw power on bullet precision passes made while their feet are set (except on high/low throws).

abilities.name: Nasty Streak - Bronze
abilities.description: Improved impact block wins against DBs & LBs
abilities.overallDescription: Blockers with this ability will dominantly win impact blocks against linebackers and defensive backs when playing as a lineman or fullback.

abilities.name: Playmaker

abilities.overallDescription: Receivers with this ability will immediately and precisely react to a user's playmaker inputs.

abilities.name: Spin Cycle - Bronze
abilities.description: Grants steerable spin animations
abilities.overallDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable spin animations.

abilities.name: Mid Elite - Bronze
abilities.description: Improved catching on medium passes
abilities.overallDescription: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10-20 yards from the LoS

abilities.name: Matador - Bronze
abilities.description: Slightly resists dominant bull rush moves
abilities.overallDescription: Blockers with this ability have protection against dominant bull rush moves attempted by defenders

abilities.name: Runoff Elite - Bronze
abilities.description: Grants more convincing runoffs
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability will distract defenders for longer with their runoffs

abilities.name: Cadence Cloak - Bronze
abilities.description: Slightly increases defender delay on silent count.
abilities.overallDescription: Cause defenders to react slightly slower on silent count snaps.

abilities.name: Juke Elite - Bronze
abilities.description: Grants steerable juke animations.
abilities.overallDescription: Steerable juke animations.

abilities.name: Sleight of Hand - Silver
abilities.description: Improved chance of success on pump fakes & double moves
abilities.overallDescription: Passers with this ability have an increased success rate when using pump fakes on double-move routes against zone coverage.

abilities.name: Locked In - Bronze
abilities.description: Reduced Zone objectives in the 4th quarter
abilities.overallDescription: Easily enter the Zone in the 4th quarter.

abilities.name: Strip Mastery
abilities.description: Enables steerable strip tackles
abilities.overallDescription: Steer toward ball carriers when attempting strip tackles.

abilities.name: Persistent - Bronze
abilities.description: Harder to knock out of The Zone in the 4th quarter
abilities.overallDescription: Harder to knock out of The Zone in the 4th quarter.

abilities.name: Conditioning - Gold
abilities.description: Ball carrier skill moves do not cost stamina
abilities.overallDescription: Do not have any stamina costs when attempting skill moves.

abilities.name: Chuck Out - Silver

abilities.overallDescription: Defenders with this ability apply bonus fatigue to their target after a successful zone chuck

abilities.name: Stiff Arm Mastery - Bronze
abilities.description: Elite stiff-arm animations
abilities.overallDescription: More powerful stiff arm animations.

abilities.name: B.O.G.O. - Gold
abilities.description: Grants three free pass rush moves after performing one
abilities.overallDescription: Gain three free pass rush moves once per play after spending stamina to perform one.

abilities.name: Ransacked - Bronze
abilities.description: Slightly increases fumble chance on sacks.
abilities.overallDescription: Slightly more likely to cause fumbles when sacking the QB.

abilities.name: Chuck Out - Gold
abilities.description: Zone chucks greatly fatigue the receiver
abilities.overallDescription: Defenders with this ability apply a large amount of bonus fatigue to their target after a successful zone chuck

abilities.name: Linchpin - Silver
abilities.description: Grants stronger blocking from all o-linemen
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability grant improved blocking to the entire offensive line.

abilities.name: Spin Cycle - Gold
abilities.description: Grants the fastest steerable spin animations
abilities.overallDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability have the fastest steerable spin animations.

abilities.name: Arm Bar - Gold
abilities.description: Greatly improved stiff arms
abilities.overallDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability have more powerful stiff arm animations ; a larger timing window for landing perfect stiff arms and greatly improved success chance

abilities.name: Gift-Wrapped - Gold
abilities.description: Higher chance to complete passes to uncovered targets
abilities.overallDescription: Passers with this ability have a better chance to complete passes to any uncovered eligible receiver.

abilities.name: Juke Box - Silver
abilities.description: Grants faster steerable juke animations
abilities.overallDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability have faster steerable juke animations.

abilities.name: Persistent - Gold
abilities.description: Harder to knock out of The Zone & slower composure losses
abilities.overallDescription: Players with this ability are harder to knock out of The Zone; and lose composure slower.
